info.name: Nursa Public API V2 Webhook logs API

params.name: facilitiesIds
params.description: The facilities IDs to filter the logs.

params.name: eventType
params.description: The event type to filter the logs.

params.name: startDate
params.description: Filters logs that happened after this date

params.name: endDate
params.description: Filters logs that happened before this date

params.name: limit
params.description: Pagination parameter, use to specify the quantity of records returned

params.name: offset
params.description: Pagination parameter, use to specify the number of records to skip before starting to return results

params.name: sortDirection
params.description: Pagination parameter, use to specify the order of records by creation date, either 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending

items.docs:
Webhook logs are stored for 14 days and are used for debugging purposes.

Searching webhook logs can help you troubleshoot issues by providing detailed information about the webhook events and their payloads. This can be crucial for diagnosing problems, verifying event delivery, and ensuring your integration is functioning correctly.
